tasks.label: Run All Three
tasks.command: ./mvnw -pl linkedin-service,pinpoint-service,game-orchestrator -am install -DskipTests && (./mvnw -pl linkedin-service spring-boot:run -DskipTests > /tmp/linkedin-service.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/linkedin-service.pid; ./mvnw -pl pinpoint-service spring-boot:run -DskipTests > /tmp/pinpoint-service.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/pinpoint-service.pid; ./mvnw -pl game-orchestrator spring-boot:run -DskipTests > /tmp/game-orchestrator.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/game-orchestrator.pid; wait)

tasks.label: Stop All Three
tasks.command: for service in linkedin-service pinpoint-service game-orchestrator; do pidfile="/tmp/$service.pid"; if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then pid=$(cat "$pidfile"); if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then pkill -TERM -P "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -f "$pidfile"; fi; done
